theme: A quiet Sunday winding down; Monday wants a little prep.
greeting: A still Sunday evening in coastal Maine, Dan, with the girls at Jen's this stretch. A couple of threads are worth clearing tonight so Monday starts clean.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: Eugenia offered Monday between noon and 2 PM ET or Thursday for a PRI catch-up; confirm a slot tonight if you want the Monday window.

needsAttention.title: Mike's pre-op confirmations
needsAttention.detail: Mike's oral surgery is Thursday in Portland. The prep list has you confirming pre-op instructions with the surgeon's office by tomorrow, and a driver plus insurance by Tuesday. Overdue in Personal Tasks since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: A take for the 2 PM Mike call
needsAttention.detail: You and Mike talk at 2 PM Monday. He floated reaching out to Sustainalytics' now-abandoned stewardship clients after Morningstar's exit, so it helps to arrive with a point of view.

flagged.title: Public Policy SVP work authorization
flagged.detail: A recruiting note on the Senior VP, Global Public Policy role asks you to confirm work authorization to keep the application moving; the sender looks automated, so verify before sharing anything.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: A reminder puts your next visit with Dr. Snowden on Tuesday at 10 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley proxy materials
flagged.detail: Proxy voting materials arrived for a Morgan Stanley private-markets holding.

inbox.noise: The usual Sunday reading — New Yorker, WSJ, NYT Cooking's Bourdain kale soup, NYPL, Patreon.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is waiting on you tonight.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: An open Sunday with nothing on the calendar to answer to.
The afternoon stayed clear in coastal Maine, the girls with Jen this stretch.
A still evening — a good window to clear a few threads before the week starts.
